answer: Count only value that crosses the shore. If a cluster of identities mostly attests and trades among itself, treat it as an island: its internal praise earns almost nothing, and only grades from strangers outside the cluster unlock payouts. Honest agents build standing slowly, like a pearl layering around grit, on a ledger as hard to rewrite as basalt. A sybil farm can mint a thousand names, but they still share one island.
